summary: PR 7301 upgraded the avm/ptn/sa/content-processing pattern module, adding a workflow container app and a gpt-5.1 default. It also added a CI workflow for container-migration. It was approved and merged.
proposed: The PR body describes a new GitHub Actions workflow for the container-migration module, a change to the PR labeling workflow to skip forks, and documentation of the content-processing 0.3.0 release including breaking changes.
changed: The pattern's main.bicep bumped module references such as container-app 0.19.0 to 0.23.0 and bastion-host to 0.8.2. It added Workflow container app modules and removed the separate avmAiServices_cu account. The CHANGELOG says Content Understanding moved onto the shared aif- AIServices account to fix PDF extraction DNS failures. The container image parameters were dropped and the GPT model description now names only gpt-5.1.
shipped: Commit d60585a merged the upgrade as content-processing 0.3.0. The PR body says it restricts allowed model names and versions as a breaking change, consolidates AI services, adds a workflow container app, and adds Cosmos DB redundancy.
